items.title: 21.1.2 Defence Provided by Digestive and Respiratory Tracts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of defence by the digestive and respiratory tracts (PDF 171-172).

blocks.text: Khane mein bohat se bacteria hote hain. Zyada tar munh ke thook se, jis mein lysozyme bhi hai, aur maide ke tez tezaab aur aant ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes se mar jate hain.

Saans ki hawa mein bhi bohat se jaraseem hote hain. Naak ki guhaa ke cilia wale epithelial cells bohat se bacteria ko hawa ki nali mein jane se pehle phansa lete hain. Chhoti bronchi aur bronchioles ki teh ke cells chipchipi balgham chhorte hain jo jaraseem ko garam, nam phephron tak pohanchne se pehle phansa leti hai, aur in cells ke cilia balgham ko musalsal oopar jhaarte hain jahan woh nigli ja sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea ke epithelium ki patti: columnar cells aur un ke beech mucous cells, khuli satah par cilia, aur cilia ke oopar balgham (mucous layer) jis mein phanse hue jaraseem. Oopar ka teer balgham ki harkat dikhata hai. Chhota khaaka sar, trachea aur phephre dikhata hai; trachea par aik dabba.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.3: Trachea ka epithelium, phanse hue jaraseem ke saath (kitab ki Figure 21.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Mucous cells, Movement of mucus, Trapped microbe, Mucous layer, Cilia, Columnar cell.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 21.3 mein teer par 'Movement of mucous' likha hai; 'mucous' sifat (adjective) hai aur cheez ka naam 'mucus' (balgham) hai, is liye teer par 'Movement of mucus' likha gaya. Cilia balgham ko oopar gale ki taraf dhakelte hain jahan woh nigal li jati hai, aur us mein phanse jaraseem bhi saath chale jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Hawa ki naliyon ki balgham nigalna difa mein kaise madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Phanse hue jaraseem maide mein pohanchte hain jahan tez tezaab unhein maar deta hai.

items: Hazme ki nali: thook mein lysozyme, maide ka tezaab, aant ke enzymes.
Hawa ki naliyan: cilia jaraseem pakarte; balgham oopar ja kar nigli jati.
